name: graphwing-implement-slice
description: Walks one bounded slice using the declared trigger inputs documented in the catalog. gitStatus → gitCheckout → sliceFrontier → fileHead ticket → agentRun → testRun → sliceComplete → gitCommit/gitPush. Completed primary/fallback callbacks retain diagnostic-v1 evidence; pre-callback failures use compact diagnostic stage receipts, routing remains one-hop, and provider recovery is checked only at a later invocation boundary. On red, files stay. Chained webhook continuation via kick_url is known-disabled because current webhook runs do not create CTX.INPUT.

index.description: Repo-relative path to slices index JSON

ticket.description: Optional ticket path; must already be on the frontier. Omit to take the next build.

iters_left.description: Set to 2 to resume the same native session with a compact test signal

kick_url.description: https Rewst webhook for the next slice

e2e.description: Optional tests.json name run after the map is empty, before CI
